# scc_organization_segment (Data Source)

Look up an existing OrganizationSegment object. Set identity or name to select it.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `identity` (String) Identity used to look up the object.
- `name` (String) Maps to the -Name parameter.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Object identifier (GUID).
- `user_group_filter` (String) Maps to the -UserGroupFilter parameter.
